methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series B → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.9x) to $30M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 3 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Climate & Energy. Range: $700M - $3.0B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Ideon Technologies is a Series B-stage climate and energy company founded by Gary Agnew, having raised $30M+ to date. The valuation exercise benchmarks against a comp universe of 9 private and 1 public company operating in the same sector, including peers such as KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $30M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implying a $57M valuation. The peer-median method references three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $700M to $3.0B and a median of $1.0B, directly implying $1.0B. This wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in business maturity and capital requirements within frontier energy technologies.

The two-method triangulation produces a range of $48M to $1.1B with a median estimate of $528M. The stage-progression floor reflects minimal financing-based upside; the peer ceiling anchors to market-observed valuations at Series C. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around Ideon's specific technology readiness, capital intensity pathway, and competitive positioning relative to the reference set. Resolution of these factors—particularly near-term capital requirements and technology validation milestones—will be necessary to narrow the range materially.
